title: Korean-Style Andouille Skewers
description: A spicy and savory keto dish perfect for a rainy monsoon season, featuring Korean-inspired flavors and andouille sausage.
instructions: Cut the andouille sausage into 1-inch pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the sausage, Korean chili flakes, garlic, and green onions. Toss to coat.
Thread the sausage mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with Rainy-Day Olive Oil and season with Monsoon-Seasoned Salt.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sausage is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with Jjokkang slices and additional green onions if desired.
